prompt:
A multi-panel storyboard of one continuous scene of a live-action short drama: one image divided into a grid of 3 columns and 4 rows of equal 9:16 panels, 12 panels read from left to right and top to bottom; cells after the last panel stay plain white. Every panel is a clean photorealistic cinematic film still with natural skin texture and real adult faces, the same light and colour in every panel. Thin plain white gutters separate the panels. Image 5: the location JI FAMILY LIVING ROOM, the back view, turned 180 degrees, facing the front wall, with the left wall at its right edge, with no people

Image 10: the prop document envelope; use only structure, material, and color
Keep each character's face, hairstyle, body and outfit exactly as in their reference image. Use the character sheets only for the characters, not for their layout, white background or multiple views. Use the location images only for the space, materials and light. There is only one of each vehicle, piece of furniture and prop that the location shows, defined by the location images, throughout all panels; when a panel shows only part of one, such as a car's hood, it is that same object, and no second one appears. Each panel shows only the characters it names, and nobody appears twice in one panel.
At the start: Ji Hongyuan sits in the middle of the long beige sofa, facing the low marble-and-gold coffee table. Lu Shaoze stands with his head down on the ivory carpet, on the far side of the coffee table, facing the sofa. One kraft document envelope lies on the coffee table in front of Ji Hongyuan. The younger Ji Ran stands half hidden behind the marble column nearest the hallway, by the wall that runs behind the columns. Tall French windows show garden trees in the sun. The camera is on the French windows side of the room, looking across the coffee table toward the marble columns, and stays on that side.
Panel 1: Close-up, locked-off camera, eye-level through the French windows. Garden leaves sway in warm sunlight beyond the glass, casting dappled light.
Panel 2: Wide shot, high angle from the French windows side, slow pan from the windows to the sofa. Ji Hongyuan sits on the beige sofa. Lu Shaoze stands with his head bowed across the marble coffee table from him, and the document envelope lies between them.
Panel 3: Medium close-up, high angle on the coffee table. Ji Hongyuan sweeps the document envelope off the marble table with the back of his hand, and it drops onto the ivory carpet at Lu Shaoze's feet.
Panel 4: Medium shot, over-the-shoulder shot from behind Lu Shaoze onto Ji Hongyuan, eye-level. Lu Shaoze's lowered head is in the foreground. Ji Hongyuan leans back on the sofa and stares at him with contempt.
Panel 5: Close-up, low angle up into Lu Shaoze's bowed face. Lu Shaoze keeps his eyes on the envelope on the carpet. His jaw tightens and his hands curl at his sides.
Panel 6: Medium close-up, low angle on Ji Hongyuan from the coffee table. Ji Hongyuan points a ringed finger at Lu Shaoze.
Panel 7: Close-up, locked-off camera, eye-level. Ji Hongyuan snorts and looks away.
Panel 8: Medium shot, high angle over the coffee table. Lu Shaoze bends down and picks the document envelope up off the ivory carpet.
Panel 9: Wide shot, pan following Lu Shaoze from the coffee table to the marble columns, eye-level. Lu Shaoze walks with the envelope toward the hallway along the marble columns, eyes fixed ahead.
Panel 10: Medium close-up, locked-off camera on the column nearest the hallway, eye-level. The younger Ji Ran is half hidden behind the marble column with her eyes wet and fixed on Lu Shaoze, who walks past in the soft foreground without turning his head.
Panel 11: Extreme close-up insert of her hand. Ji Ran's fist clenches tight against the marble column.
Panel 12: Medium shot, handheld, high angle, pull out from Ji Ran. Ji Ran slumps back against the wall beside the column, her chest heaving as she struggles to breathe.
Keep the characters' identities and outfits, the number and position of every vehicle, piece of furniture and prop, and the location's spatial orientation consistent across all panels.
No text, letters, numbers, captions, speech bubbles, panel labels or watermark anywhere in the image; no sketch or comic style.
